summary: Iteration 5 verification of admin safe-delete (multi-select + delete-all w/ DELETE double confirmation), creator status change, broadcast custom-recipient autocomplete (waitlist + creators), signature CRUD, chart-hover tooltip, range selector, and per-section Framer Motion scroll animations. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_admin.py with 21 tests (19 non-destructive + 2 destructive). 19/19 non-destructive pass (login OK, bulk-delete 422 on wrong confirmation + 200 deletes on DELETE for both waitlist & creators, status-change valid/invalid/404 paths, user search 2-char gate + 20-cap + waitlist+creator source merge, signature full CRUD + 409 on duplicate + default 'Revenge Arc Original' auto-creation, public POST regression both endpoints). Full regression: 89/90 pass across all 5 test files (1 pre-existing Resend daily-quota flake on test_email_creator from iter1 suite — same env-only failure documented in iter4). Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end on real admin dashboard: login w/ Bashar1212, growth chart + tooltip ('Feb 1, 26 / Waitlist 0 / Creators 0'), all 8 range buttons clickable, Waitlist select-all + delete-selected, DeleteConfirmModal correctly disables Confirm when input is empty or wrong-case 'delete' and enables on exact 'DELETE', Creators tab has 53 rows with mix of approve/reject buttons (35) AND change-status menus (18), Broadcast tab shows all 7 recipient cards, Custom Recipients reveals search input, typing 'test' returned 20 autocomplete results with both waitlist+creator sources, clicking result added chip, NEW signature modal saved and listed correctly with 'Signature saved' toast, landing page full-height (17633px) scroll-through completed with zero console errors and 10/11 section anchor IDs found (gym-buddie section uses id='coach' — not a regression, just naming). All TEST5_ seed data cleaned up post-run via API.

minor.issue: test_email_creator from iter1 suite returns sent=false due to Resend daily quota exhaustion in shared preview env — same flake from iter3/iter4, environmental only, not iter5 code regression

Iter5 review-only: creator-application schema requires why_support + audience (uncovered while updating test seeders) — this is correct product behavior but iter5 test report flags it so the next agent doesn't get tripped

action_items: (Optional) Either rename GymBuddieSection's <section id='coach'> to id='gym-buddie' for nav consistency OR document the 'coach' anchor — currently the section uses id='coach' while review_request referenced 'gym-buddie'. No user-facing impact, the section renders + animates correctly.

(Environment-only, no action) Resend daily-quota flake on /admin/creators/{id}/email persists in shared preview env — same as iter3/iter4. Production unaffected. Consider mocking resend in pytest, or making the test pass when error contains 'quota'.

(Code hygiene, deferred from iter4) server.py line 26 fallback default still 'Revengearchelp@gmail.com' — fine, but consider extracting email shell to email/template.py since server.py is 819 lines (over the 700-line guideline).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 819 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into auth.py, admin_routes.py, public_routes.py, email/template.py before next iteration.

AdminDashboard.jsx is 800 lines and Broadcast.jsx is 624 lines — both at the threshold. Extracting DeleteConfirmModal, StatusMenu, GrowthChart, SelectionBar (all already named internally) into separate files would improve maintainability.
Bulk-delete + delete-all endpoints correctly require literal 'DELETE' (case-sensitive, validated by 422 returns for 'delete', 'Delete', 'DELET' — all confirmed in tests).

/api/admin/users/search correctly applies min 2-char filter server-side (not just client-side), correctly escapes '.' in regex via .replace('.', r'\.'), caps at 20 results, dedupes by email across waitlist + creators, exposes 'source' field for UI labeling — solid implementation.
Signature endpoints properly handle 409 duplicates including on PUT (with $ne id self-exclusion). Default signature seeded lazily via _ensure_default_signature on every GET — idempotent and safe.

Frontend uses data-testid on every critical interactive element (delete-confirm-input, delete-confirm-btn, recipient-search-results, search-result-<email>, signature-modal, signature-save-btn, chart-tooltip, range-<id>, recipient-<group>) — excellent testability.
